description: The branch-3 holonomy t^2 acceptance test is a BAR-SYMMETRY test in disguise. alpha's t^2 coefficient is exactly 1/4 + z'(1); the c*ln q prediction is 1/4; so alpha is second-order logarithmic iff z'(1) = 0 — and bar-evenness FORCES z'(1) = 0 (differentiate z(1/q) = z(q) at the bar fixed point q=1). z_C is bar-even, z_D is not. So convention D failing the t^2 test is NOT independent evidence against the 2026-08-15 ruling; it restates the already-known fact that z_D is not bar-even. Corollary: acceptance-test part 1 has no discriminating power for route 5, since it tests the Markov parameter rather than the holonomy hypothesis. Neither convention is a logarithm: alpha is ALGEBRAIC (rational in sqrt q under C, in q under D) while c*ln q is transcendental, and alpha_C already deviates at t^3.

checks.name: c_pinned_to_minus_half_C
checks.why: C: z(1) = 1/2 so the t^1 coefficient pins c = -1/2

checks.name: c_pinned_to_minus_half_D
checks.why: D: z(1) = 1/2 so the t^1 coefficient pins c = -1/2

checks.name: bar_even_forces_zprime_zero
checks.why: differentiating z(1/q) = z(q) at q=1 gives -z'(1) = z'(1)

checks.name: not_bar_even_zD_has_nonzero_zprime
checks.why: z_D'(1) = 1, so nothing forces the t^2 match

checks.name: t2_test_passes_exactly_for_the_bar_even_convention
checks.why: C passes the holonomy t^2 test, D fails it — and the discriminator is bar-evenness, not the holonomy hypothesis

checks.name: C_is_not_a_logarithm_either
checks.why: alpha_C - c*ln q first deviates at t^3, so the agreement is second-order, not exact

checks.name: alpha_is_algebraic_so_exact_agreement_is_impossible
checks.why: alpha_C is a rational function of sqrt(q), alpha_D of q; c*ln q is transcendental, so no exact agreement is possible in either

data.verdict: DEFLATION. The t^2 tension recorded in qou-pdix entry (6) is not an independent objection to convention D — it is bar-evenness restated. Acceptance-test part 1 is therefore not a test of route 5; parts 2 and 3 (the -1/4 of Re(log-gap) with the discarded i*pi, and a value below 1) remain the real test.
